name: E-commerce and retail
metaTitle: Reconciliation for E-commerce and Retail Finance Teams | Fincile
metaDescription: Order, payout, stock and ad-spend reconciliation for online and retail businesses, using exports from the tools you already have.
intro: Online and retail businesses have several systems that should agree: the store, the payment processors, the bank, the stock system and the ad platforms. Fincile compares any two of them from exports.
pains: Orders marked paid with no matching processor charge, or charged twice
Processor payouts that arrive net of fees and are booked in pieces
Stock counts that differ from the system after a stock take
Agency or ad platform invoices that do not match reported spend

uses.how: Compare store orders with processor charges, for Shopify or any store that exports orders.
Check each Stripe, PayPal or Adyen payout against what was booked.
Compare a stock take with system quantities for each SKU.
Compare reported campaign spend with agency invoices.

dataNote: Fincile has a separate Shopify app for installed stores with live sync for Stripe and PayPal. The workspace product on this page compares files and works with any platform.

faqs.q: Do I need the Shopify app to use this?
faqs.a: No. The workspace product works from CSV and Excel exports of any store. The Shopify app is a separate product for stores that want audits inside Shopify.

faqs.q: Can I reconcile several sales channels together?
faqs.a: Combine the channel exports into one file and keep the channel in the description column, or run one reconciliation per channel.

name: Healthcare and insurance billing
metaTitle: Claims and Remittance Reconciliation for Billing Teams | Fincile
metaDescription: Compare claims billed with payments received to find unpaid, underpaid and instalment-paid claims, without uploading patient details.
h1: Reconciliation for billing and revenue cycle teams
intro: Billing teams need to know which claims were paid, which were underpaid and which are still open. Fincile compares a list of submitted claims with the remittance lines you received.
pains: Claims that were never paid and are not on anyone's list
Payments below the billed amount that nobody questioned
One claim paid in several instalments, so totals look wrong
Remittance lines for claims that were never billed

uses.how: Pair each claim with its remittance lines and list shortfalls.
Apply patient or payer payments to open balances.
Check that deposits in the bank match what remittances say was paid.

dataNote: Do not upload protected health information. Use claim IDs and amounts, and remove patient names and identifiers. Fincile has not been assessed for HIPAA and does not sign business associate agreements.

faqs.a: Fincile has not been assessed against HIPAA and does not claim compliance. Remove patient identifiers before uploading.
No. Convert remittance data to CSV or Excel first.

name: Property management
metaTitle: Rent and Deposit Reconciliation for Property Managers | Fincile
metaDescription: Match tenant rent ledgers to bank deposits, vendor statements to payables, and card spend to expense claims across a property portfolio.
intro: Property managers collect rent into several accounts and pay many vendors. Fincile compares the tenant ledger with the bank, and vendor statements with what you recorded.
pains: Rent paid in parts or one transfer covering several units
Vendor statements that disagree with the payables ledger
Card spend by site managers that never reached an expense claim
Deposits that arrive on different days from the ledger entry

uses.how: Use the unit number as the reference and match tenant ledger lines to bank deposits.
Apply a single transfer to several units or months.
Check contractor and utility statements against payables.
Match site card spend to claims.

dataNote: Property managers use the same templates as accounting teams. Map the unit or lease ID as the reference column. Fincile is not property management software and does not track leases.

faqs.q: Is there a rent roll template?
faqs.a: Not as a separate template. The bank reconciliation and cash application templates work when you map unit or lease ID as the reference.

faqs.q: Can I keep each property separate?
faqs.a: Create a workspace per portfolio, or include the property code in the reference.

name: Agencies and professional services
metaTitle: Reconciliation for Agencies and Professional Services | Fincile
metaDescription: Check ad spend against client billing, match client payments to invoices and tie out expenses for agencies and consultancies.
h1: Reconciliation for agencies and professional services
intro: Agencies and consultancies pass costs through to clients and wait on payments. Fincile checks that what you spent, what you billed and what you were paid line up.
pains: Pass-through ad spend that differs from what the client was billed
Clients paying several invoices in one transfer
Contractor and software costs on cards that never reach an expense claim
Commission or revenue-share statements that cannot be checked

uses.how: Compare platform spend with client invoices per campaign.
Apply client payments to the invoices they settle.
Match team card spend to claims.
Check partner statements against closed deals.

dataNote: Everything here compares files you export. Fincile does not connect to ad platforms or billing tools in workspaces today.

faqs.q: Can I run this for several clients?
faqs.a: Use one workspace per client for separate access, or one workspace with a run per client.
Add them as viewers. Viewers can read results and cannot run or change anything.
